::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 13th 1887  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Columbia University Library, New York:  Harper Bros Collection
:::

[Gentlemen](organizations/other_248.qmd)

I am much obliged for [£10](organizations/other_160.qmd) for the [publication](organizations/other_172.qmd) of the [Modern Telemachus](cmy_books/cmybook_185.qmd)  I am sending the receipt to [Mr Asgood](people/person_2367.qmd)

I remain &c
C M Yonge		

Messrs Harper

---

**Note:** The collection also includes a stamped receipt.
